new_description: Light disruptor array for Hideki-pattern fighters. Disruptors break down the target's molecular bonds, and this one does it from a small hull. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it fires the fastest and is the sturdiest for its size, but has the shortest reach.
The spiral-wave disruptor is the standard gun of Cardassian warships, with a firing arc wide enough for a long patrol. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it hits the softest.
The array carried by Galor-class cruisers, the workhorse of the Cardassian fleet. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it fires the fastest, but does the least to armour.
A heavier array for the Keldon-class, which shares the Galor's hull under a larger superstructure. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it fires the fastest, but does the least to armour.

A trial array built for the Central Command's testing yards. Hand-tuned, and not yet ready for the line. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it hits the hardest and fires the fastest, but is the frailest for its size.
An experimental array that pushes the rapid nadion effect of Cardassian disruptors past its normal limit. Of the Cardassian beam weapons, it reaches the farthest and fires the fastest.
The aft disruptor wave cannon of the Galor-class, a close-in weapon that fires in short bursts. Of the Cardassian cannon weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A larger wave cannon, fitted to heavier ships. Of the Cardassian cannon weapons, it fires the fastest and fires the largest salvos.
The biggest wave cannon the Union ever mounted on a ship, meant for hammering defended worlds. Of the Cardassian cannon weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest, but fires the slowest.
A single-tube launcher for escorts and light cruisers. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it hits the softest.
Launcher for the Galor-class, built to fit alongside the disruptor banks. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but fires the slowest.
A heavier launcher for the Keldon-class. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it has the fastest shots, but has the smallest blast.
A launcher for the largest cruisers of the fleet.
A heavy launcher for ships built to break defended worlds. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it is the cheapest for its size and has the widest blast.
The heaviest launcher in the fleet, made to reduce fortress stations. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it hits the hardest and has the widest blast, but has the slowest shots.
An experimental launcher, still on the testing range. Of the Cardassian torpedo weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest, but has the slowest shots.

An orbital weapon platform carried three disruptor arrays. Many were built to guard the home worlds so the fleet could be used offensively. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
The System-5 disruptor was a planetary defence weapon, never designed to move. It guarded outposts like Korma. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it fires the slowest.
A heavy disruptor cannon for a station's ring. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it has the fastest shots, but fires the slowest.
A battery of cannons spread around a station's habitat ring. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it has the fastest shots.
A battery mounted on the pylons of a Nor-pattern station. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it is the cheapest for its size and has the fastest shots, but is the frailest for its size.
The largest battery in the Union's fortress stations, covering whole sectors of sky. Of the Cardassian orbital cannon weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest.
A lance for outposts, firing a narrow beam. Of the Cardassian orbital beam weapons, it is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A beam array for a station's ring.
A beam array for the pylons of a Nor-pattern station.

The long lance of the Union's fortress stations, which no ship can safely approach. Of the Cardassian orbital beam weapons, it hits the hardest and reaches the farthest, but is the frailest for its size.
A fixed tube for stations and garrisons. Of the Cardassian orbital torpedo weapons, it fires the fastest and is the sturdiest for its size, but hits the softest.
A launcher for a station's garrison, kept loaded in case of attack. Of the Cardassian orbital torpedo weapons, it fires the fastest, but has the slowest shots.
A garrison launcher with a reinforced magazine. Of the Cardassian orbital torpedo weapons, it has the fastest shots, but fires the slowest.
A long-reach launcher used to hold off a fleet at a distance. Of the Cardassian orbital torpedo weapons, it reaches the farthest and fires the fastest, but is the costliest for its size.
The heaviest launcher on a Cardassian station, built to crack a fleet. Of the Cardassian orbital torpedo weapons, it hits the hardest and is the cheapest for its size, but fires the slowest.
